jewishness.translation: n. 犹太人身份；犹太教徒身份

jewison.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 朱伊森取自父名或母名，来源于Julian,含义是“朱利安之子”(son of Julian)

jewkes.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 朱克斯取自父名, 来源于Jekyll,含义是“杰基尔之子”(son of Jekyll)

jewry.translation: n. 犹太人区, [总称] 犹太人, 犹太民族

jews.definition: n a person belonging to the worldwide group claiming descent from Jacob (or converted to it) and connected by cultural or religious ties
jews.translation: n. 犹太人, 犹太教（Jew的复数形式）

jewstone.definition: n. A large clavate spine of a fossil sea urchin.

jex.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 杰克斯取自父名，来源于Geach,含义是“吉奇之子”(son of Geach)

jez.translation: n. (Jez)人名；(匈、匈)耶兹；(瑞典)耶斯

jezebel.definition:
n. wife of Ahab who was king of Israel; according to the Old Testament she was a cruel immoral queen who fostered the worship of Baal and tried to kill Elijah and other prophets of Israel (9th century BC)
n. a shameless impudent scheming woman
jezebel.translation:
n. 无耻放荡的女人
[电] 用以探测海底和把水底分类的系统

jezebels.definition:
plural of jezebel
n. wife of Ahab who was king of Israel; according to the Old Testament she was a cruel immoral queen who fostered the worship of Baal and tried to kill Elijah and other prophets of Israel (9th century BC)
n. a shameless impudent scheming woman
jezebels.translation:
(jezebel 的复数) n. 无耻放荡的女人
[电] 用以探测海底和把水底分类的系统

jezekite.translation: 红磷钠矿, 柱晶磷矿
